clue.text: Amorous Italian — an objectionable person, they say

parts.note: a Roman is an Italian from the capital

indicators.note: they say signals that a word spoken aloud gives the letters

parts.note: a tick is British slang for a contemptible, objectionable person

explanation.surface: An amorous Italian man is rumoured to be an unpleasant character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'they say' is the homophone signal: tick, British slang for a contemptible person, is heard after the Italian city-dweller.
explanation.definitionFit: Romantic describes someone given to love and courtship, which is what amorous means.

clue.text: Reprove a community for being grasping

parts.note: to rap is to rebuke or reprove
a city is a community of people

explanation.surface: Scolding a town for its greed.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapacity is greed, the quality of being avaricious and grabbing.

clue.text: Mother, grandmother, daughter, son, together from childhood

parts.note: ma is mother
nan is grandmother
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A family of three generations who have lived close together since early years.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'man and boy' means throughout one's life since youth.

clue.text: Indian statesman — he boards vessel that's capsized

indicators.note: capsized turns the result upside down, reading upwards in this down clue
boards, as one boards a ship, puts he inside the vessel

parts.note: an urn is a vessel

explanation.surface: An Indian leader climbs aboard a boat that overturns.
explanation.walkthrough: HE 'boards' URN to give URHEN, then 'capsized' reads it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Jawaharlal Nehru was India's first prime minister.

clue.text: Not all black fish under suspicion

indicators.note: under places the fish below the black word in this down clue
not all signals the word for black loses its last letter

parts.note: inky means black
ling is a sea fish

explanation.surface: Some dark fish are suspected of something.
explanation.definitionFit: An inkling is a vague hint or slight idea that something is so.

clue.text: Provide entertainment fit for a king — Barmecide's conclusion

parts.note: regal means royal, fit for a king

indicators.note: the conclusion of a word is its final letter, taken here from Barmecide's

explanation.surface: Hospitality fit for a king, though the Barmecide's lavish feast turns out empty.
explanation.walkthrough: The Barmecide, in the Arabian Nights, served a beggar an imaginary feast, so the surface teases entertainment that never arrives; only his last letter E is used.
explanation.definitionFit: To regale is to entertain or feast someone lavishly, as a host does with guests.

clue.text: Gay song that's moving at a comfortable pace

indicators.note: moving signals the letters are set in motion and rearranged

parts.note: i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A cheerful tune that travels along at a relaxed tempo.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy-going describes a relaxed, unhurried manner, a leisurely gait.

clue.text: Fear displayed by provincial army

indicators.note: displayed by signals the letters are shown within the words provincial army

explanation.surface: Panic shown by regional troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Alarm is sudden apprehension or fright.

clue.text: Property in eastern country

parts.note: a state is a country

explanation.surface: Real estate in an eastern nation.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is land or possessions owned.

clue.text: Take a short cut around church that's picturesque

indicators.note: around signals the shortened cut goes round the church letters
short signals the word for a cut loses its last letter

parts.note: a snick is a small cut or nick
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A shortcut past the church gives a lovely view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' drops the last letter of the cut word, and 'around' wraps it about the Church of England abbreviation; 'Take a' is surface padding.
explanation.definitionFit: Scenic means offering pleasant views of the landscape.

clue.text: Horsepower

parts.note: read as two words: a heavy draught horse breed (the Suffolk ___) and a word for power or force

explanation.walkthrough: The Suffolk Punch is an English heavy horse breed; punch also means forceful power, so the single word splits into horse + power.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a breed of heavy draught horse and forcefulness or impact.

clue.text: To get engine going thrills a girl

parts.note: kicks are thrills or excitement
tart is an old slang word for a girl or woman

explanation.surface: Starting the motor gives a young woman a buzz.
explanation.definitionFit: To kick-start a motorcycle is to start its engine by stamping on a pedal.

clue.text: Old soldier in counter-revolution

indicators.note: a revolution turns things round, so the letters of in and counter are rearranged

explanation.surface: A veteran fighter takes part in an uprising against a revolution.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphenated 'counter-revolution' splits in two: its first half joins 'in' as anagram fodder, and 'revolution' is the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A centurion commanded a hundred men in the ancient Roman army, so is a soldier of long ago.

clue.text: Many units initially within gun's range

indicators.note: within signals one piece placed inside the gun word

parts.note: gat is old American slang for a gun

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letters of Many and units

explanation.surface: Lots of troops are positioned within reach of the artillery.
explanation.definitionFit: A gamut is the full range or scope of something, originally the whole span of musical notes.

clue.text: Can man sent to prison…

parts.note: Toby is a man's name
jug is slang for prison

explanation.surface: A man who can be sent to jail, the sentence trailing off into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis joins this to 16 across as one sentence, but each clue is solved alone. Can here is a drinking vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A Toby jug is a drinking mug shaped as a seated figure, and can is slang for such a container.

clue.text: Saint Joseph, a reincarnation of Franco

parts.note: Jo is short for Joseph

indicators.note: a reincarnation gives new form, so the letters of a and Franco are rearranged

explanation.surface: A saint called Joseph believed to be the dictator Franco reborn.
explanation.definitionFit: The French heroine of Orléans was canonised in 1920.

clue.text: … a carpenter, buy supper here?

explanation.surface: Continuing the sentence: the jailed man is a woodworker, and asks where to get food.
explanation.walkthrough: Chippy is British slang for a carpenter, and also for a fish-and-chip shop where people buy a takeaway supper.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a joiner or woodworker, and the everyday British name for a fried fish takeaway shop.

clue.text: Lying reports circulating about a leader of troops

indicators.note: about signals the shuffled letters go round the remaining piece
circulating signals the letters of reports are moved round
leader of picks the first letter of troops

explanation.surface: False rumours spread concerning a military commander.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circulating' rearranges REPORTS to PROSTRE, which goes 'about' A plus T.
explanation.definitionFit: Prostrate means lying face down, stretched out flat.

clue.text: Wooden panelling supplied by wagons to small house

parts.note: wains are farm wagons
a cot is a small cottage

explanation.surface: Timber boards delivered by cart to a cottage.
explanation.definitionFit: Wainscot is panelling lining the lower part of an interior wall.

clue.text: Energetic person brings a lot of people back into the party

indicators.note: into signals one piece placed inside the party word

parts.note: do is an informal word for a party

indicators.note: back signals the word for many people is read backwards

parts.note: many means a large number of people

explanation.surface: A lively host draws a crowd back to the celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns MANY into YNAM, which goes 'into' DO.
explanation.definitionFit: A dynamo is a figurative term for a tirelessly active, forceful person, like a generator of power.

clue.text: Love daughters — boy-child is favourite

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O
D for daughter, doubled for the plural
a son is a male child

explanation.surface: Doting on the girls while the boy is the parents' pet.
explanation.definitionFit: An odds-on runner is the betting favourite, expected to win.

clue.text: Soldier's returned with a girl, a wife from overseas

indicators.note: returned means the soldier's letters are read backwards

parts.note: GI is an American soldier; with the possessive it gives GIS
Nora is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A soldier has come home with a woman he married abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Signora is the Italian title for a married woman, so a foreign wife.

clue.text: Second offspring of mare laps horse in run

indicators.note: laps means wraps around, so the mule goes round the horse

parts.note: a mule is the offspring of a mare and a donkey
gee-gee, GG, is a child's word for a horse

explanation.surface: A mare's foal overtakes another horse during a race.
explanation.walkthrough: A mule, foaled by a mare to a donkey sire, 'laps' (wraps round) the nursery word for a horse; 'run' means bring in contraband.
explanation.definitionFit: To run contraband is to bring it in illicitly.

clue.text: Muffler set up to suppress a row

indicators.note: to suppress means to hold down inside, so the scarf letters enclose a
set up reads the scarf word upwards in this down clue

parts.note: a muffler is a scarf

explanation.surface: A car's silencer is raised to stop an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns SCARF into FRACS, which holds A 'to suppress' it.
explanation.definitionFit: A fracas is a noisy quarrel or brawl.

clue.text: Receiver runs and loses the point — one-love

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

indicators.note: loses signals letters taken away from the word and

parts.note: N, north, is a point of the compass
I is the Roman numeral one
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: A tennis match report: the receiver runs, drops the point and trails at one-love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses' removes N from AND, leaving AD.
explanation.definitionFit: A radio set is an apparatus that picks up broadcast signals, so it is a receiver.

clue.text: Object found in grave not complete

indicators.note: not complete signals the last letter of the word for grave is dropped

parts.note: demure means sober and grave

explanation.surface: Something discovered in a tomb is incomplete.
explanation.definitionFit: To demur is to raise an objection or protest.

clue.text: Old clothing being worn, a short suit

parts.note: a doublet is a close-fitting jacket of the Renaissance period
on means being worn, as clothes are

explanation.surface: A vintage outfit is being worn, a trim little suit.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'short suit' is not clothing: in bridge it is a holding of only two cards in a suit.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge, a holding of exactly two cards in a suit is a short suit of that name.

clue.text: One given accommodation by fat land owner in Scotland

indicators.note: given accommodation means housed, so one sits inside the fat word

parts.note: lard is pig fat
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A lodger housed by a portly Scottish landlord.
explanation.definitionFit: A laird is the Scots term for an estate proprietor.

clue.text: Hurry up and progress

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a call to get a move on, and also means to advance or develop.

clue.text: Newton's 'Principia' inspired suddenly — an apple contributed

definitions.text: Newton's 'Principia' inspired suddenly — an apple contributed

indicators.note: principia is Latin for beginnings or first things, so the opening letters of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: The falling apple that suddenly inspired Newton's great book on gravity.
explanation.walkthrough: Newton's famous work title doubles as the signal: Latin 'principia' means first parts, so take the initials of the last five words.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Isaac Newton is the scientist whose apple inspiration the whole clue describes.

clue.text: Trim a tree

explanation.definitionFit: Spruce means neat and smart, and is also a kind of conifer.

clue.text: Tie providing both cold and warmth

parts.note: dead, as in a dead body, is cold
heat is warmth

explanation.surface: A neck tie that keeps you both cool and warm.
explanation.walkthrough: Tie is a drawn race, not neckwear.
explanation.definitionFit: A dead heat is a race finishing level, an exact draw.
